info.title: BreakingJam API
info.description: The central place for breaking jams. Authenticated calls use the `bj_session` cookie set by register, login or Google sign-in.

get.summary: The process is up and the database answers.

post.summary: Create a password account and log in.
Log in with email and password.

401.description: Unknown email, wrong password or Google-only account

post.summary: End the current session; succeeds without one too.

get.summary: The logged-in account; also slides the session 30 days forward.
Start Google sign-in (a browser navigation, not a fetch).

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Same-site path to land on after sign-in.

get.summary: Where Google sends the browser back; ends on the frontend either way.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code; absent when the user cancelled.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state echoed back by Google.

303.description: Logged in: to `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` + `next`, except a new account coming from the jam form, which goes home. Failed: to `/login?error=google`

get.summary: List public jams, or your own with `mine=true`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only jams in this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only jams still running on or after this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only jams starting on or before this date.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: `true` lists the caller's own jams, drafts included (organiser list page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, defaulted and clamped by `page::limit`.

post.summary: Register a jam as a draft; a first jam makes a `user` an `organizer`.

post.summary:
Move a jam along draft → in_review → published → registration_closed → completed, or
cancel it; the BreakingJam team publishes drafts without review.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.description: `publish` is for `seed_admin`+; cancel is allowed from any status but completed

schema.description: An explicit status change: the last segment of `POST /events/{id}/{transition}`.

404.description: No such jam, or a draft you can't see

409.description: The current status does not allow it

get.summary: The generated 4:5 flyer of a jam (DESIGN.md §4.24), as SVG to inline in the page.

get.summary:
The city a search names, case and accents aside: an exact name or alternate name first,
else one starting with the search; when several match, one with a public jam nearby, then
the most populated.

Battle.description: A competition inside a jam, e.g. "1v1 Bboy".

bracket_size.description: Starting bracket after prelims; null = unknown.

prize_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the prizes, e.g. `CHF`; null when there are none.

prize_first.description: Cash prize for 1st place, in whole units of `prize_currency`.

position.description: Display order on the jam page.

starts_at.description: When it starts, as wall-clock time in the jam's timezone; null until announced.

updated_at.description: Last write, maintained by a trigger.

BattleFields.description: Everything set when creating or editing a battle.

name.description: Free text; blank means "generate from the structured fields".

team_size.description: 1 = 1v1 … 10 = 10v10; required for team battles, absent otherwise.

age.description: Age category; kids need `age_max` of 17 or less, adults `age_min` of 18 or more.

bracket_size.description: Starting bracket after prelims: 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64; null = unknown.

prize_currency.description: ISO 4217 code, upper case (`EUR`, `CHF`, `CNY`…); required when a prize is set.

prize_first.description: Cash prize for 1st place, in whole units.

prize_second.description: Cash prize for 2nd place, in whole units.

prize_third.description: Cash prize for 3rd place, in whole units.

starts_at.description: When it starts, wall-clock time in the jam's timezone, on one of its days; null = not announced.

BattleOrder.description: Body of `PUT /events/{id}/battles/order`: every battle id of the jam, in display order.

BattleRef.description: The battle side of a participation.

BracketStage.description: Furthest stage an entry reached; `Winner` is first place.

Category.description: What the map's category chips filter on, derived from a battle's structured fields.

Claim.description: A claim as its author sees it.

code.description: Shown to the user, who puts it in their Instagram bio or DMs it to @breaking.jam.

reviewed_at.description: When an admin decided; null while pending.

ClaimForReview.description: A claim in the admin review queue, with who is claiming which page.

email.description: Login email, so the admin can reach them.

CountryBattles.description: How many battles a country's public jams hold.

updated_at.description: Last write, maintained by a trigger.

CrewDetail.description: A crew with its current members.

CrewFields.description: Everything set when creating or editing a crew.

instagram_handle.description: `@handle` or `handle`; blank is stored as null.

CrewName.description: A crew as named on an entry.

CrewRef.description: A crew as shown next to a dancer.

Dancer.description: A stored dancer; `user_id` and `created_by` are never serialized.

aliases.description: Other names the dancer goes by.

instagram_handle.description: Lower case, no `@`; the identity key when present.

verified_at.description: Set once a claim is approved; the UI shows a verified tick.

avatar_url.description: Uploaded picture; null means the generated avatar.

avatar_parts.description: The generated avatar's parts, e.g. `h2-s1-c0-o3-e0-b1`; null means seeded from the id.

merged_into_id.description: Set when an admin merged this row into another; it is then only a redirect.

updated_at.description: Last write, maintained by a trigger.

DancerEvents.description: Body of `GET /dancers/{id}/events`: upcoming by date, past most recent first.

upcoming.description: Jams starting today or later, soonest first.

DancerFields.description: Everything set when creating or editing a dancer.

dancer_name.description: Stage name, up to 100 characters; not unique.

aliases.description: Other names the dancer goes by, at most 10.

instagram_handle.description: `@handle` or `handle`; the identity key when present, unique case-insensitively.

avatar_parts.description: The generated avatar's parts (DESIGN.md §4.16); blank or absent means seeded from the id.

DancerPage.description: Body of `GET /dancers/{id}`: the page, or where a merged dancer now lives (§4 "Merge").

DancerRef.description: A dancer as linked from a jam page: enough to render the name, avatar, flags and handle.

avatar_url.description: Uploaded photo; null = the generated pixel avatar.

avatar_parts.description: The pixel avatar's chosen parts; null = seeded from the id.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may `PUT` this dancer.

DancerResponse.description: A dancer page (§6): profile, current crews, and whether the caller may edit it.

DancerSource.description: Where a dancer row came from (§4 "Dancer identity").

DancerSummary.description: A search result: enough to tell two "Lil G"s apart (§4: name · @handle · country · crew).

aliases.description: Other names the dancer goes by.

verified.description: Whether an approved claim links the page to its owner.

avatar_url.description: Uploaded picture, which replaces the generated avatar.

avatar_parts.description: The generated avatar's chosen parts; seeded from the id when null.

Entry.description: A registration in a battle, with its members and result.

team_name.description: Team name for crew and duo entries; null for 1v1.

video_url.description: Canonical YouTube watch link of the battle video.

video_offset_seconds.description: Where the battle starts inside the video.

updated_at.description: Last write, maintained by a trigger.

EntryFields.description: Everything set when registering or editing an entry; results are optional on create.

team_name.description: Null for 1v1; blank is stored as null.

crew_id.description: The crew this entry represents, if any.

final_rank.description: Exact placement when known; filled from `reached` for `winner` (1) and `top2` (2).

ErrorBody.description: What went wrong; `fields` only for validation errors.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Body of every error response (§5 Error handling).

error.description: The error itself, under a single key so clients can test for it.

organizer_id.description: The account that created it and owns it.

slug.description: Stable public URL segment; never changes after creation.

status.description: Where it is in its lifecycle.

starts_on.description: First day, in the jam's timezone.

city.description: City shown on cards and in the map popup.

lat.description: Latitude; set together with `lng` or not at all.

lng.description: Longitude; set together with `lat` or not at all.

contact_email.description: Where to write to the organisers; public.

flyer_url.description: The organiser's 1080×1350 flyer; null means the generated one.

flyer_card_url.description: The same flyer at 540×675, for cards, lists and the map; set with `flyer_url`.

review_note.description: Why an admin sent it back to draft; null otherwise.

updated_at.description: Last write, maintained by a trigger.

EventFields.description: Everything an organiser sets when creating or editing a jam.

description.description: A short pitch, up to 200 characters; blank is stored as null.

ends_on.description: Last day; must not be before `starts_on`.

venue_name.description: Venue; blank is stored as null.

address.description: Street address; blank is stored as null.

lat.description: Latitude; set together with `lng` or not at all.

lng.description: Longitude; set together with `lat` or not at all.

registration_url.description: Where dancers sign up; blank is stored as null.

instagram_url.description: The jam's Instagram page; blank is stored as null.

website_url.description: The jam's own website; blank is stored as null.

contact_email.description: Public contact address; blank is stored as null.

EventRef.description: The jam side of a participation.

status.description: Where it is in its lifecycle.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit it, change its status or delete it.

oneOf.description:
Who runs it: the jam page's organiser card (M12c); null when the BreakingJam team

EventResponse.description: A jam page: the jam, and whether the caller may edit it.

EventStatus.description: Lifecycle of a jam (§4 "Event status transitions").

FeatureCollection.description: `GET /events.geojson` body: a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of points.

features.description: One feature per jam with coordinates.

field.description: Field name as sent by the client.

FlyerUpload.description: `POST /events/{id}/flyer` body: one 4:5 crop, cropped and encoded in the browser.

flyer.description: 1080×1350 JPEG of at most 2 MB, for the jam page.

card.description: 540×675 JPEG of at most 400 KB, for cards, lists and the map.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the visitor's country; null when unknown.

status.description: Always `"ok"`; any failure returns the error envelope instead.

version.description: Crate version of the running binary.

MapJam.description: What the map popup needs (§6 Map).

battles.description: Battle names in display order: the popup's category line.

categories.description: What the map's category chips match, from all battles, without repeats.

flyer_card_url.description: The uploaded flyer at 540×675; null means the generated one.

Member.description: A current member as shown on a crew.

into.description: The surviving dancer; `{id}` becomes a redirect to it.

MergeResponse.description: Result of a merge: the survivor that now carries everything.

aliases.description: The survivor's aliases, now including the loser's names.

instagram_handle.description: The survivor's handle, taken from the loser when it had none.

others_pending.description: Another account has a pending claim on the same page; both go to review.

MyClaim.description: Your claim on a dancer page, and whether someone else is claiming it too.

Organizer.description: An organiser's page; never the account's email or role.

display_name.description: Public name, shown on their jams.

verified_at.description: Set when an admin confirmed the handle; cleared when the handle changes.

code.description: Shown to the organiser, who puts it in their Instagram bio or DMs it to @breaking.jam.

reviewed_at.description: When an admin decided; null while pending.
